page.overview:
Who is Omega?

Omega appears as a boss and card in the Chocobo series.

Omega appears as the last of the game's optional bosses, after Shinryu. It can be encountered on floor 99.

Omega is an optional boss on floor 24 of the Secret Dungeon.

Defeating Omega with a Bottle rewards Chocobo with the Omega Essence, needed to craft the strongest equipment. Curiously, Omega is vulnerable to the Blood Suck ability that can be forged into a set of claws through the use of a Vampire Essence. Claws with this ability have a random chance of reducing a targeted enemy to 1 HP, making it easier to capture their essence.
